column1: #  - class is class, interface is interface, enum and abstract are class (the type, not its constructors), typedef is type_alias;
#  - a function or constructor (`new`) in a class or interface body is method; a function at the top level of a module is function;
#  - a var in a class or interface body (static, final or not) is field;
#  - enum constructors, typedef members, locals and function arguments are not definitions.
# Each construct sits in a file of its own where the grammar needs it: this grammar reports an error for a
# whole region around an enum, an abstract or an object-literal typedef, see KNOWN_GAPS.md.
